title: SZA MBTI Quiz: Which SZA Song Matches Your Personality?
description: What is SZA's MBTI type, and which SZA song matches yours? Take this 12-question quiz to compare your personality with SZA's fan-typed MBTI.

questions.text: Your friends drag you out when all you wanted was to hide. Once you're there...

options.text: You somehow become the life of the whole function
You find one person and vibe quietly in a corner
You're dancing on the couch by midnight
You sneak out early for the quiet drive home alone

questions.text: A SZA song comes on at the party. You...

options.text: Scream every lyric and pull everyone around you into it
Mumble along in your own little bubble
Turn it into a full group performance
Save it for your headphones later, where it hits right

questions.text: When heartbreak hits, how do you actually handle it?

options.text: Call every friend and talk in circles until it makes sense
Go silent and disappear into music alone
Go out and flirt with the first person who looks your way
Stay in bed replaying every moment privately

questions.text: Looking back at a relationship, you fixate on...

options.text: The actual moments: the texts, the dates, the things they really did
What the whole thing meant about who you are
What actually happened, not what you imagined at 3am
The hidden patterns you can now read into every chapter
Real, concrete things: a home, stability, more good days
Reinventing yourself completely, again and again
Small perfect moments you can actually touch
A version of you nobody has ever met before

questions.text: A new SZA track drops. First thing you do is...

options.text: Fixate on the beat and replay the one exact line you love
Map the whole song onto your life story
Learn every lyric word for word
Decide it's about one specific chapter of your life

questions.text: An ex texts you at 1am. You...

options.text: Calculate the response that costs you the least dignity
Feel it straight in your chest and answer honestly
Leave it on read — logically, it changes nothing
Reply anyway, because emotions don't run on logic

questions.text: A friend keeps going back to someone who's bad for them. You...

options.text: Lay out the evidence as plainly as you can
Listen and support, knowing feelings aren't a choice
Tell them straight exactly what you would do
Hold them through every repeat of the cycle

questions.text: You decide whether to forgive someone based on...

options.text: Whether the math of that relationship still works
How much love you still genuinely have for them
Their actions and track record, period
Your gut, your heart, and the way they make you feel
A plan: you know what you want and refuse to settle
A beautiful mess you navigate purely by feeling
Standards and boundaries you defend
Situationships that shift with the tide

questions.text: When you're falling for someone, you...

options.text: Decide fast and commit to the feeling
Let it unfold messily, mood by mood
Define what it is early so nobody gets played
Keep your options open as long as you possibly can

questions.text: Your playlist for the week is...

options.text: Carefully curated, and you stick to it
Total chaos, updated hourly by mood
The same songs on repeat until they've done their job
Twenty genres held together by pure vibes

results.title: 20 Something (INFP)
results.description: You're '20 Something' - navigating life's big questions with vulnerability and grace. You're reflective, creative, and not afraid to feel deeply.

results.title: Good Days (INFJ)
results.description: You're 'Good Days' - finding hope even in difficult times. You're introspective and always searching for peace.

results.title: Kiss Me More (ENFP)
results.description: You're 'Kiss Me More' - playful, romantic, and bring energy to relationships. You love connection and intimacy.

results.title: The Weekend (ENFJ)
results.description: You're 'The Weekend' - the generous lover who puts others first. You shine when helping and supporting your people.

results.title: Kill Bill (INTJ)
results.description: You're 'Kill Bill' - strategic and calculated. When someone wrongs you, you plan your revenge methodically.

results.title: Normal Girl (INTP)
results.description: You're 'Normal Girl' - marching to your own beat. You don't conform to expectations and embrace your uniqueness.

results.title: Snooze (ENTP)
results.description: You're 'Snooze' - keeping people on their toes. Dynamic, unpredictable, and always bringing fresh perspectives.

results.title: Power is Hard (ENTJ)
results.description: You're 'Power is Hard' - ambitious and unapologetic about your goals. You know what you want and go for it.

results.title: Blinks (ISFP)
results.description: You're 'Blinks' - artistic and sensitive. You express yourself through creativity and value your personal space.

results.title: Shirt (ISTP)
results.description: You're 'Shirt' - cool under pressure. You keep your emotions in check and stay composed in tough situations.

results.title: PSA (ESFP)
results.description: You're 'PSA' - bold and unapologetic. You speak your truth loudly and don't care what others think.

results.title: F2F (ESTP)
results.description: You're 'F2F' - direct and bold. You never shy away from tough conversations and value honesty.

results.title: Ghost in the Ghost (ISFJ)
results.description: You're 'Ghost in the Ghost' - nurturing and protective. You're always there for your people, often putting their needs first.

results.title: Too Well (ISTJ)
results.description: You're 'Too Well' - loyal and consistent. You show up for your people and remember the important details.

results.title: Love Language (ESFJ)
results.description: You're 'Love Language' - affectionate and devoted. You express care through actions and being present.

results.title: Die Tryin (ESTJ)
results.description: You're 'Die Tryin' - driven and determined. You're always working toward your goals and never give up.

share_hook: Most people match to a familiar SZA track, but about one in five lands on a deep cut that reveals their hidden energy. Which song would you get?
